title: Button
description: A native button with a restrained set of intent, size, and loading states.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the button and communicates progress.

useWhen: The user needs to submit, confirm, or move forward.
avoidWhen: The action is navigation; use a native link instead.
constraints: Use one primary button per form or task region.
Keep the label action-first and specific.

title: Textarea
description: A labelled native multiline text field with help, error, and required states.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Optional prompt for the expected content.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event retargeted from the shadow root.

useWhen: A user must enter a short-to-medium length multiline value.
avoidWhen: The response is a single short value; use ov-input instead.
constraints: Always provide a visible label; placeholder text is not a label.
Keep the field sized to the expected response rather than the entire page.

title: Checkbox
description: A labelled native checkbox for boolean settings and selectable options.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires the checkbox to be selected.

events.name: change
events.description: Native change event retargeted from the shadow root.

useWhen: A user needs to turn one independent option on or off.
avoidWhen: The user must choose exactly one option; use ov-select or a radio group.
constraints: Keep the visible label next to the control and meaningful without color.
Group related checkboxes with a native fieldset and legend.

title: Radio group
description: A labelled native radio group for choosing one option from a short list.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires one option to be selected.

events.name: change
events.description: Native change event retargeted from the shadow root.

useWhen: The user must choose exactly one option from a short, visible list.
avoidWhen: The list is long or the user may select several options; use ov-select or ov-checkbox instead.
constraints: Use a meaningful group label and keep each option label concise.
Group related choices with a native fieldset and legend.

title: Toggle
description: A compact native switch for an immediate boolean setting.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires the switch to be enabled.

events.name: change
events.description: Native change event retargeted from the shadow root.

useWhen: A setting should switch on or off immediately without opening another flow.
avoidWhen: The user is selecting among options or triggering a one-time action; use ov-radio-group, ov-checkbox, or ov-button instead.
constraints: Keep the switch compact and pair it with an explicit text label.
Use a toggle for an immediate setting, not for a submission or navigation action.

title: Input
description: A labelled native text input with help, error, and required states.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event retargeted from the shadow root.

useWhen: A user must enter a short, single-line value.
avoidWhen: The response is long-form; use a native textarea until a dedicated recipe exists.
constraints: Always provide a visible label; placeholder text is not a label.

title: Dialog
description: A native dialog for interruptive decisions with explicit open and modal semantics.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is currently shown.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether opening blocks the rest of the document with a modal backdrop.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether the close action and Escape can dismiss the dialog.

events.name: close
events.description: Dispatched when the dialog closes through its close action, Escape, or an external open change.

events.name: cancel
events.description: Dispatched when Escape requests dismissal; cancel the event to keep the dialog open.

useWhen: A decision is genuinely interruptive and the user must resolve it before continuing.
avoidWhen: The message can stay in page context; use ov-alert or an inline confirmation instead.
constraints: Provide a specific heading and an action that explains the consequence.
Use modal=true only when losing the current context is acceptable or essential.
Keep the body concise and offer a clear way to dismiss when the decision is not mandatory.

title: Select
description: A labelled native select for a small, known set of options.

events.name: change
events.description: Native change event retargeted from the shadow root.

useWhen: The choice list is short enough to scan without search.
avoidWhen: There are more than roughly eight options or options need rich descriptions.
constraints: Provide a useful empty prompt when the field is not required.

title: Badge
description: A compact status or category marker for short labels.

useWhen: A short status adds useful scan context.
avoidWhen: The label is a paragraph or the only way information is conveyed.
constraints: Use text that remains meaningful without color.

title: Card
description: An article-like surface for grouping related content and actions.

useWhen: A related set of content needs a clear boundary.
avoidWhen: The page is already composed of many nested bordered surfaces.
constraints: Keep card hierarchy shallow; prefer one card per task or information group.

title: Alert
description: An inline message with an appropriate live-region role.

useWhen: The user needs feedback that persists in the page context.
avoidWhen: The feedback is a transient toast or a field-level validation message.
constraints: Danger messages should explain what happened and the next action.

title: Page header
description: A consistent page title block with optional context and actions.

useWhen: A screen needs a clear title and optional task-level actions.
avoidWhen: The content is a modal or a small card with its own heading.
constraints: Use exactly one page header per main region.
Reserve the primary action for the page's main task.

title: Empty state
description: A calm, actionable explanation for a collection with no items.

useWhen: A user understands the collection but it currently has no results.
avoidWhen: The page failed to load; show an error state instead.
constraints: Name a specific next action when one exists.

title: Data table
description: A compact, labelled table for comparable records and row actions.

useWhen: Users need to compare the same fields across multiple records.
avoidWhen: Each record needs a long narrative or the layout is primarily visual.
constraints: Keep columns to the fields required for the task.
Provide an empty state when rows are absent.

title: Application shell
description: A responsive app frame with a labelled navigation rail and main content region.

useWhen: Multiple screens share a persistent navigation model.
avoidWhen: The page is a one-off landing screen or a focused modal flow.
constraints: Keep navigation labels short and ordered by frequency.
Use one main landmark inside the shell.

title: Spinner
description: A small inline loading indicator with an accessible status label.

useWhen: A local task is still running and the surrounding context should remain visible.
avoidWhen: The page is empty or an urgent failure needs explanation; use ov-empty-state or ov-alert instead.
constraints: Keep the label specific to the work in progress.
Keep loading inline rather than replacing the whole page.

title: Menu
description: A compact action menu with keyboard navigation and a floating surface.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible trigger label and fallback text.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu actions assigned as a property.

events.name: open
events.description: Dispatched when the menu opens.

events.name: close
events.description: Dispatched when the menu closes.

events.name: select
events.description: Dispatched when an enabled menu item is selected.

useWhen: Several related actions need a compact floating surface.
avoidWhen: The action is the primary task or the choices need persistent explanation; use ov-button or page content instead.
constraints: Keep the trigger label and menu items action-first.
Use the trigger slot for label content only; do not nest another interactive control.
Menus close on Escape and restore focus to their trigger.

title: Pagination
description: A compact result page navigator.

events.name: change
events.description: Dispatched when the selected page changes.

useWhen: A collection spans multiple result pages and users need to move through it deliberately.
avoidWhen: There is only one page or continuous loading better matches the task.
constraints: Keep data fetching and row ownership outside the component.
Expose the current page through aria-current and announce page changes.

title: Combobox
description: A labelled searchable listbox for a longer set of known options.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Optional prompt for the expected choice.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires an option to be selected.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the option list is visible.

events.name: input
events.description: Dispatched as the user filters the options.

events.name: change
events.description: Dispatched when an option is selected.

useWhen: The option list is too long to scan comfortably in a native select.
avoidWhen: There are only a few options; use ov-select instead.
constraints: Provide a visible label and keep option labels concise.
Keep filtering local to the supplied options; remote fetching belongs to the owning application.
Support Arrow keys, Enter, Escape, and visible focus without removing the native input.

title: Tabs
description: A controlled tablist with keyboard navigation and named panel slots.

props.name: items
props.description: Tab definitions assigned as a property.

events.name: change
events.description: Dispatched when an enabled tab is selected.

slots: ${value}: panel content for each tab value

useWhen: Users need to switch between related views that share the same context.
avoidWhen: The choices are independent destinations; use native links or application navigation instead.
constraints: Assign stable values and concise labels to every tab.
Provide panel content through a named slot matching each tab value.
Keep keyboard focus within the tablist predictable with Arrow, Home, and End keys.

title: Toast
description: A transient, dismissible notification for cross-context status feedback.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds before automatic dismissal; zero disables it.

events.name: close
events.description: Dispatched when the notification is dismissed by the user or timer.

useWhen: A short-lived status needs to reach users while they are working elsewhere in the interface.
avoidWhen: The message explains a persistent page condition or field error; use ov-alert or field validation instead.
constraints: Place toasts in an owning live region and keep messages concise.
Provide a dismissal path and pause automatic dismissal while the notification is hovered or focused.
Do not use a toast as the only record of a destructive or required action.

title: Progress
description: A labelled native progress indicator for determinate or indeterminate work.

props.name: max
props.description: Total amount represented by the progress value.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Communicates progress without a known completion amount.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the calculated percentage beside the bar.

useWhen: A task has measurable completion or needs an explicit indeterminate work signal.
avoidWhen: The operation is a short local wait with no useful completion estimate; use ov-spinner instead.
constraints: Keep value and max meaningful to the owning task and update them from application state.
Use a concise visible label so the native progress semantics have context.
Do not imply completion when the application has not confirmed it.

title: Skeleton
description: A decorative loading placeholder for reserving the shape of incoming content.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text or heading lines.

useWhen: A known content shape should remain reserved while its data loads.
avoidWhen: The layout does not benefit from geometry reservation or the content can remain visible with an inline status.
constraints: Mark the owning content region aria-busy while placeholders are shown.
Treat the placeholder as decorative and keep meaningful loading text in the owning region.
Match the placeholder shape to the content it replaces without implying unavailable detail.

title: Accordion
description: A native disclosure group for revealing related content on demand.

props.name: items
props.description: Disclosure definitions assigned as a property.

props.name: openItems
props.description: Values of the currently expanded disclosures.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether more than one disclosure may remain open.

events.name: change
events.detail: { value: string; open: boolean; openItems: string[] }
events.description: Dispatched when a disclosure opens or closes.

slots: ${value}: panel content for each item value

useWhen: Related content can be progressively disclosed without changing the page task.
avoidWhen: Users need to compare panels simultaneously or switch between peer views; use visible sections or ov-tabs instead.
constraints: Assign stable values and concise labels to every item.
Provide panel content through a named slot matching each item value.
Keep the first useful answer visible when the content is essential to completing the task.

title: Slider
description: A labelled native range control for bounded numeric values.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the current value beside the label.

events.name: input
events.description: Dispatched while the value changes.

events.name: change
events.description: Dispatched when the value is committed.

useWhen: A user needs to choose a value within a bounded numeric range and the relative position is meaningful.
avoidWhen: The exact number matters more than relative adjustment; use ov-input with an appropriate numeric type instead.
constraints: Provide a visible label and meaningful min, max, and step values.
Show or otherwise expose the current value when the result is not obvious from the control.
Keep the owning application responsible for formatting and applying the selected value.

title: File upload
description: A labelled native file picker with optional drag-and-drop support.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted file types passed to the native picker.

props.name: files
props.description: Selected files assigned by the component after picking or dropping.

events.name: change
events.description: Dispatched when files are selected or dropped.

useWhen: A task needs one or more user-provided files as an attachment or import input.
avoidWhen: The application can create the data locally or a simple text field is sufficient.
constraints: Keep the native file input available to keyboard and assistive technology users.
Validate type, size, and content in the owning application rather than trusting accept.
Show selected filenames and communicate errors near the field.

title: Tooltip
description: A supplemental tooltip that opens for pointer hover and keyboard focus.

props.name: content
props.description: Supplemental explanation shown in the tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: Fallback trigger label when no trigger slot is provided.

slots: trigger: the control or label that receives the supplemental description

useWhen: A control or concise label needs a brief supplemental explanation on hover or focus.
avoidWhen: The content is required to understand or operate the control; use a visible label or help text instead.
constraints: Keep tooltip content short and supplemental.
Support both pointer hover and keyboard focus, and allow Escape to dismiss.
Never rely on a tooltip as the only accessible name for an interactive control.

title: Avatar
description: A compact identity marker with image, initials, and status fallbacks.

props.name: name
props.description: Identity used for the accessible label and initials.

events.name: image-error
events.description: Dispatched when the image cannot load and the initials fallback is shown.

useWhen: A user, member, owner, or contributor needs a compact visual identity marker.
avoidWhen: The identity is unknown or the label would be clearer as text alone.
constraints: Provide a meaningful name and keep the accessible label descriptive.
Use an image only when it adds reliable identity value; initials remain the fallback.
Treat presence status as supplemental and do not communicate critical state by colour alone.

title: Breadcrumbs
description: A compact linked hierarchy with a clearly identified current location.

props.name: items
props.description: Linked hierarchy assigned as a property.

useWhen: A nested resource or detail page benefits from a persistent path back to its parent locations.
avoidWhen: There is no meaningful hierarchy or a single back link communicates the route more clearly.
constraints: Use real links for parent locations and make only the final item current.
Keep labels short enough to wrap or truncate without hiding the current location.
Keep application routing and data ownership outside the component.
